references.title: Critical Assessment of protein Structure Prediction
Guide to Gene Ontology evidence codes

nodes.title: Biomolecule identity and context provenance
nodes.summary: Bind a benign biomolecule claim to a stable identifier, declared biological context, source provenance, and bounded intended interpretation.
artifactRequirements: A stable public identifier or synthetic fixture identifier with source and version metadata.
A declared organism-free or benign-context scope and an explicit statement of excluded interpretations.
Digests for every public metadata artifact; no raw sequence payload is carried by the profile.
revalidationTriggers: The identifier mapping, source edition, molecular context, or safety classification changes.

nodes.title: Function annotation with evidence provenance
nodes.summary: Separate curated or computational annotation from direct functional measurement and preserve the evidence code behind each assertion.
artifactRequirements: A version-pinned annotation record and its evidence classification.
A machine-readable distinction between inferred annotation and measured function.
A conflict report for contradictory annotations or obsolete identifiers.
revalidationTriggers: The annotation, evidence code, source record, or identifier mapping changes.

nodes.title: Gene-expression assay design and metadata
nodes.summary: Freeze study design, controls, sample metadata categories, endpoints, exclusions, and analysis intent before interpreting expression measurements.
artifactRequirements: A versioned design record covering controls, declared endpoints, exclusions, and metadata completeness.
A de-identification statement limiting public evidence to non-identifiable aggregate or synthetic metadata.
Repository-ready metadata shaped by applicable community submission guidance.
revalidationTriggers: The cohort definition, context, endpoint, control plan, or metadata standard changes.

nodes.title: Expression context and normalization
nodes.summary: Make comparison context, normalization choices, batch structure, exclusions, and uncertainty inspectable without treating preprocessing as biology.
artifactRequirements: Pinned input-metadata and analysis-environment digests with a bounded comparison definition.
A declared normalization and batch model with negative and sensitivity checks.
An uncertainty report that separates processing effects from scoped biological interpretation.
revalidationTriggers: The comparison set, normalization rule, batch model, exclusion rule, or analysis environment changes.

nodes.title: Protein abundance and localization evidence
nodes.summary: Require direct protein-level and localization evidence before advancing beyond transcript abundance, with context and uncertainty kept explicit.
artifactRequirements: Direct protein-level measurement metadata with controls and uncertainty.
Localization-specific evidence when a localization conclusion is requested.
An explicit comparison showing why transcript evidence alone is insufficient.
revalidationTriggers: The measurement platform, detection model, localization method class, or biological context changes.

nodes.title: Regulatory association evidence
nodes.summary: Record reproducible association under a frozen design while refusing to relabel correlation as regulation or causality.
artifactRequirements: A frozen association model with covariates, denominator, exclusions, and uncertainty.
Independent reproduction metadata from effectively distinct control clusters.
A machine-readable non-causality label on every association-only result.
revalidationTriggers: The population, context, covariates, denominator, association model, or exclusion rule changes.

nodes.title: Bounded regulatory causality
nodes.summary: Advance from association only with bounded perturbational evidence, direct endpoints, prospective evaluation, and effective independent reproduction.
artifactRequirements: A preregistered bounded causal claim and prospectively frozen evaluation criteria.
Perturbational evidence with direct molecular endpoints and declared negative controls.
Independent reproduction across disclosed control, method, and context roots.
revalidationTriggers: The intervention class, endpoint, context, model, control structure, or causal claim changes.

nodes.title: Transcript quantification with uncertainty
nodes.summary: Produce bounded transcript-abundance conclusions with complete metadata, controls, uncertainty, and an explicit wall against protein-level claims.
artifactRequirements: A bounded transcript-abundance result with denominator, uncertainty, and negative controls.
Complete non-identifiable metadata sufficient to inspect processing and comparison context.
An explicit statement that transcript abundance does not establish protein abundance, localization, or function.
revalidationTriggers: The assay, quantification model, reference annotation, denominator, or comparison context changes.

nodes.title: Calibrated fold-model evidence
nodes.summary: Bind an in-silico structural model to input provenance, model and environment digests, calibration, and a scoped confidence statement.
artifactRequirements: Pinned model, parameter, input-metadata, and execution-environment digests.
Calibration against a frozen benchmark or held-out class with bounded uncertainty.
A statement separating predicted coordinates and confidence from folding mechanism, kinetics, and measured function.
revalidationTriggers: The model, parameters, input metadata, benchmark, calibration method, or execution environment changes.

nodes.title: Fold ensemble and uncertainty
nodes.summary: Compare model ensembles and uncertainty under bounded assumptions without converting sampled conformations into an unsupported pathway or kinetic claim.
artifactRequirements: A frozen ensemble definition with model-lineage, sampling, and environment digests.
Uncertainty decomposition and sensitivity checks across effectively distinct methods.
An explicit refusal to infer pathway or kinetics from static or sampled coordinates alone.
revalidationTriggers: The ensemble, sampling assumptions, method lineage, calibration, or target context changes.

nodes.title: Fold-to-function evidence
nodes.summary: Link a bounded structural hypothesis to direct functional evidence and prospective evaluation without allowing annotation or model confidence to substitute for function.
artifactRequirements: A preregistered structural-to-functional claim with prospectively frozen evaluation criteria.
Direct functional evidence, declared controls, uncertainty, and scope bounds.
Independent reproduction that discloses control, method, and context roots.
revalidationTriggers: The structural hypothesis, functional endpoint, context, control plan, or prospective criterion changes.

nodes.title: Blind and held-out fold-model benchmarking
nodes.summary: Evaluate model performance on frozen blind or held-out targets, disclose lineage and leakage risks, and report failure classes rather than one headline score.
artifactRequirements: A frozen target set, scoring definition, denominator, exclusions, and model cutoff.
A leakage and lineage analysis covering training overlap, templates, tools, and shared infrastructure.
Per-class uncertainty and failure reporting with an independently executable scoring artifact.
revalidationTriggers: The target set, scoring rule, denominator, model cutoff, lineage disclosure, or benchmark status changes.

nodes.title: Genotype-to-expression-to-phenotype chain
nodes.summary: Join bounded causal expression evidence to a phenotype endpoint while preserving every context, denominator, uncertainty, and non-implication boundary.
artifactRequirements: A graph of separately evidenced genotype, expression, protein, and phenotype links with no inferred edge hidden.
Prospectively frozen endpoints, denominators, controls, uncertainty, and context bounds.
Independent reproduction with conflict-cluster and method-lineage disclosure.
revalidationTriggers: Any linked claim, endpoint, denominator, context, causal model, or provenance record changes.

nodes.title: Variant-to-fold-to-function chain
nodes.summary: Join variant context, calibrated fold evidence, and prospective functional evidence without converting model confidence into biological function.
artifactRequirements: A graph of separately evidenced variant, structure, model, and function links with explicit uncertainty at every edge.
Prospectively frozen functional criteria and independent reproduction metadata.
A lineage and leakage report spanning data, templates, models, tools, and control clusters.
revalidationTriggers: The variant context, structural evidence, model, benchmark, functional endpoint, or lineage disclosure changes.

nodes.title: Independent cross-context replication crown
nodes.summary: Recognize only a shadow LS5 result reproduced across independent control, organization, method, and context roots after an open challenge clears.
artifactRequirements: At least three effective control clusters spanning at least two organization, method, and context roots.
Frozen claims and evaluation criteria with separately attributable confirming and contradicting results.
A clear challenge state; every open, unresolved, or upheld challenge blocks the crown.
A machine-verifiable statement that the crown creates no reward, authority, qualification, or KARMA magnitude.
revalidationTriggers: A challenge opens, a conflict relationship is discovered, a replication is withdrawn, or any bound claim changes.

nodes.title: Static structure-coordinate evidence
nodes.summary: Bind static structural coordinates to format, provenance, method context, quality metadata, and an explicit refusal to infer pathway or kinetics.
artifactRequirements: A format-valid coordinate artifact digest with source, method class, and quality metadata.
A bounded mapping from stable biomolecule context to the coordinate record.
An explicit statement that static coordinates do not establish a folding pathway or kinetics.
revalidationTriggers: The coordinate record, source revision, quality metadata, method interpretation, or biomolecule mapping changes.

nodes.title: Study provenance, controls, and safety scope
nodes.summary: Freeze a GREEN-only question, prior evidence, denominator, controls, conflicts, safety exclusions, and bounded public metadata before analysis.
artifactRequirements: A timestamped scope digest with declared question, denominator, exclusions, controls, conflicts, and stopping rules.
A GREEN-only risk assessment that refuses every v0 RED topic and sends unknown risk to private metadata-only escalation.
A public-artifact manifest containing synthetic or non-identifiable metadata only, with no sequence or operational protocol payload.
revalidationTriggers: The question, denominator, control plan, conflict graph, public-data class, or risk classification changes.
